test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 29 Jan 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: In which year was the investment in the Service sector closest to the average investment in this sector for the 5 year period?
solution:
**Given:**

Investment in three different sectors in five years

**Formula used:**

Average = Sum of values/ No. of values

**Calculation:**

Here, we have
 investment in service sector in 2004 = 120.41

Investment in service sector in 2005 = 121.47

Investment in service sector in 2006 = 187.98

Investment in service sector in 2007 = 205.67

Investment in service sector in 2008 = 119.35

Now, Average of investment in service sector in all the 5 years = ( 120.41 + 121.47 +187.98 + 205.67 + 119.35) /5 = 754.88/5 = 150.976.

 As the difference of investment in the service sector in 2004 is minimum i.e. (150.976 - 120.41) = 30.566 is the minimum as compared to all the years.

**Hence, investment in 2004 in service sector is closest to the Average investment in all the 5 year period.**
